summary_zh: 之后又按正常面试题的写法重写了题干（中英文页都用英文题干），数字和条件不变。

issues.problem_zh: 原题干是一大段长句，把条件、规模、范围和要讨论的话题全挤在一起，读起来不像面试官会说的话；中文版又是逐句硬翻。
issues.change_zh: 按正常面试题的写法重写题干：先一句话说要设计什么，再分块列出已有条件、需求和规模、要交付什么、面试官会追问的话题和不考的范围。所有数字和条件不变，参考解答没有改。按用户要求，中文页的题干也直接用英文。

checked: ran the page with tools/run_page.py, normally and with --hash-seeds (PYTHONHASHSEED 0 and 1): all PASS, about 0.2 s
recomputed every capacity number in the estimate table (transactions per second, entries, storage per day / year / 7 years, the +23.4% for transit entries, statements per day)

wrote an independent sqlite3 script: in WAL mode the second writer after two reads gets SQLITE_BUSY_SNAPSHOT, as the page says (the page's demo enables WAL; in rollback-journal mode the error differs)

wrote an independent enumeration of the write-skew case (not using the page's MVCC class): 70 interleavings; snapshot isolation worst total -100 with no abort; read-set validation and a guard row both give worst 50 with an abort

checked PostgreSQL statements against postgresql.org docs: synchronous_commit on vs remote_apply, Repeatable Read is snapshot isolation, the 'careful use of explicit locks' sentence, 'could not serialize access due to concurrent update' and '... read/write dependencies among transactions', guarantee only for committed serializable transactions, Read Committed re-checks WHERE on the new row version, unique insert waits for the uncommitted inserter then 23505 unique_violation, 40001 serialization_failure, 40P01 deadlock_detected, PREPARE TRANSACTION notes (not for applications, VACUUM / wraparound, holds locks), max_prepared_transactions default 0 and server-start only

checked SQLite statements against sqlite.org (BEGIN IMMEDIATE, one writer at a time, SQLITE_BUSY_SNAPSHOT), Kafka delivery semantics against the Kafka design docs (at-least-once by default, store offset with output, transactions give exactly-once between Kafka topics only), and the Redis Cluster acknowledged-write-loss claim against the cluster spec

checked the origin line against the interviewing.io guide (lists 'Design a banking app' under system design) and the Landed guide (lists the banking business-logic coding item); the OA banking-system reference matches the site's process page; no paths; frequency low

code_run.notes: 1 python block (sqlite3 demos plus small simulations). PostgreSQL was not run (not allowed here); its behaviour was checked against the official docs only, as the page itself says.
